name: Frust! Revolution
original_name: ふらすと！レヴォリューション
source:
Main character is an unpopular student who is often ridiculed in class. Only a few nerds keep him company. He finally meets some unique girls who don't look down on him. But it turns out that girls bring not only love. Young people approach a great test that has an impact on the world's fate.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-september-2006-pp.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名不受歡迎的學生，經常在班裡遭到嘲笑，只有幾個宅男願意陪伴他。他終於遇見了幾名不會瞧不起自己的個性獨特的女孩。然而，少女們帶來的並不只有愛情。這群年輕人即將面臨一場足以影響世界命運的重大考驗。

[出自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-september-2006-pp.html]vndbreview[/url]]
